sections.label: THINKING
sections.content:
Hmm, something went wrong. After moving UP while connected to Green:
- Red: 13-16 (moved from 25-28!)
- Blue: 19-22 (moved from 31-34!)
- Green: 25-28 (moved from 37-40, as expected)
- Agent: 24-29
So when I moved UP while connected to Green, Red and Blue also moved up! This means collected blocks above the agent DO move with the agent when moving UP. But earlier, when I moved DOWN, collected blocks below the agent did NOT move. Let me reconsider the mechanic.
Actually, looking at the results:
- Before moving UP: Red at 25-28, Blue at 31-34, Green at 37-40 (connected), Agent at 36-41
- After moving UP (3 times): Red at 13-16, Blue at 19-22, Green at 25-28, Agent at 24-29
So all three blocks moved up by 12 rows (3 moves * 4 rows per move). This means when moving UP, ALL collected blocks above the agent move with the agent, not just the connected one.
Wait, but Green was connected (uncollected), and it also moved. So the connected block moves with the agent, and collected blocks above the agent also move with the agent when moving UP.
But earlier, when I moved DOWN, Red (collected, above agent) did NOT move. So the mechanic is asymmetric:
- When moving UP: connected block + collected blocks above agent move with agent
- When moving DOWN: connected block moves with agent, but collected blocks do NOT move
This is important! So when moving DOWN, only the connected block moves. When moving UP, all blocks above the agent move.
Given this, my plan of moving Green to a temp position messed up Red and Blue. Let me reconsider.
Current state:
- Red: 13-16 (collected)
- Blue: 19-22 (collected)
- Green: 25-28 (collected)
- Agent: 24-29
Desired:
- Red: ~25-28
- Green: ~31-34
- Blue: ~37-40
So I need to move all three blocks down. Red needs to move down by ~12 rows, Green by ~6 rows, Blue by ~18 rows.
Strategy: Use the DOWN mechanic (only connected block moves) to move each block individually.
1. Move Red from 13-16 to 25-28:
   a. Move agent to Red's row (12-17) - agent is at 24-29, move UP 2 times
   b. Connect to Red
   c. Move DOWN to 24-29 - Red moves with agent
   d. Retract path - Red collects at 25-28
2. Move Blue from 19-22 to 37-40:
   a. Move agent to Blue's row (18-23) - agent is at 24-29, move UP once
   b. Connect to Blue
   c. Move DOWN to 36-41 - Blue moves with agent (4 DOWN moves)
   d. Retract path - Blue collects at 37-40
3. Move Green from 25-28 to 31-34:
   a. Move agent to Green's row (24-29) - agent is at 36-41, move UP 2 times
   b. Connect to Green
   c. Move DOWN to 30-35 - Green moves with agent (1 DOWN move)
   d. Retract path - Green collects at 31-34
Wait, but in step 1, when I move DOWN from 12-17 to 24-29, I pass through Blue's row (19-22) and Green's row (25-28). Blue and Green are collected, so they won't get auto-collected. But will they move with the agent? According to the mechanic, when moving DOWN, only the connected block moves. So Blue and Green should stay in place. Good.
But wait, in step 1c, I move DOWN from 12-17 to 24-29. That's 3 DOWN moves (12-17 -> 18-23 -> 24-29 -> 30-35). No wait, 12-17 to 18-23 is 1 DOWN, 18-23 to 24-29 is 1 DOWN, 24-29 to 30-35 is 1 DOWN. So 3 DOWN moves to reach 30-35. But I want to reach 24-29, which is 2 DOWN moves from 12-17.
Hmm, let me recalculate. The agent is 6 rows tall. Each UP/DOWN move shifts the agent by 6 rows.
- Agent at 12-17, move DOWN -> 18-23
- Agent at 18-23, move DOWN -> 24-29
- Agent at 24-29, move DOWN -> 30-35
- Agent at 30-35, move DOWN -> 36-41
So from 12-17 to 24-29 is 2 DOWN moves. And Red would move from 13-16 to 25-28 (centered within agent at 24-29). Good.
Let me execute step 1 first.
